_comment: Provenance for calibrated constants in kestrel_config.json. Production code never reads this file; tests/unit/test_calibration_consistency.py asserts the two agree. Bounds encode a reviewed safe range, not a derivation. `changed_by` names the commit that last set the value, not one that changed the logic reading it. Several values were introduced in b97d4a6 as vntyper/scripts/kestrel_filter_config.json and carried unchanged into kestrel_config.json by the split in e9c22a2.

kestrel_settings.max_align_states.rationale: Above ~50, motif-specific ALT support inflates without new variant calls, pushing single-motif calls into High/Low_Precision. Reverted from 60 to 40.

confidence_assignment.depth_score_thresh.rationale: Empirical noise floor. Below this a variant is reported Negative. The value has never changed; 7ca8950 later moved that filtering to the root of confidence_assignment.py rather than applying it as an override, but left the number alone.
Empirical boundary above which a call may reach a High_Precision tier.

confidence_assignment.alt_depth_threshol.rationale: At or below this alternate-allele depth a call is Low_Precision regardless of depth score.
Lower edge of the High_Precision alternate-depth band; alt_low + 1 by construction.

Upper edge of the High_Precision band, exclusive. At exactly 100 the call is High_Precision*; the inclusive='left' fix in fade198 stopped cond3 overwriting that. The threshold itself has never moved -- only the comparison around it.

confidence_assignment.var_active_region_.rationale: Active-region depth at or below this contributes a Low_Precision signal. NOTE: precedence is unspecified - a later High_Precision condition can override it. See spec R1; do not change without domain sign-off.

alt_filtering.gg_depth_score_threshold.rationale: Same calibrated number as depth_score_thresholds.low, stored separately for the GG alt filter. Linked - must not drift.

motif_filtering.position_threshold.rationale: Splits the VNTR into left (<60) and right (>=60) motif partitions. Carried forward unchanged from the v1 monolith, where VNtyper.py hardcoded the same POS < 60 / POS >= 60 split.
